lessons: Scene height is category-nominal, not measured dynamic height; a post-lift height guard incorrectly prevents transport.
Instance suffixes are not persistent tracking identities. Parse categories at the final underscore and use bounded spatial association.
Use basket dimensions rather than a fixed 0.2 metre containment radius.
Assign distinct baskets to distinct categories; never use modulo assignment when baskets are insufficient.
Only an explicit no_collision_free_path response guarantees zero trajectory execution. Exceptions do not justify manipulation retries.
Gripper joints and completed approach calls do not establish grasp or task success.

rationale: Removes the invalid post-lift RGB-height guard identified in development feedback. Uses normalized arm-specific orientations, dimension-based basket containment, distinct category assignments, and a short clearance lift rather than the rejected large lift. A second arm is considered only after an explicit zero-execution pre-contact planning rejection. Each spatial job receives at most one grasp attempt; uncertain execution ends the policy without arbitrary release. The native step budget is not observable, so finite call limits do not guarantee completion within it. Task outcome remains for the independent evaluator.
